Due to the actions of the [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] vessel ''[[Far Orbit]]'', a '''joint committee''' was formed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] and the [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Commerce Branch]] to hunt down the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]. It was kept in use due to an increase in [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] privateering.
